entries.title: First Sight of New Zealand
anchors: At 2 p\.m\. saw land\* \(\*\s+The North island of New Zealand\.\) from the Masthead
Gentle breezes and settled weather\. At 2 p\.m\. saw land

entries.title: Landing at Poverty Bay
anchors: MONDAY, 9th October\. Gentle breezes and Clear Weather\. P\.M\. stood into\s+the Bay and Anchored
Anchored on the North-East side before the Entrance of a\s+small River

entries.title: Queen Charlotte's Sound
anchors: TUESDAY, 16th\. Variable light Airs and Clear settled weather
we anchor'd in a very Snug Cove,\* \(\* Ship Cove, in Queen\s+Charlotte's Sound

entries.title: Landfall at Botany Bay
anchors: Sunday, 29th\. In the P\.M\. wind Southerly and Clear weather, with which we\s+stood into the bay and Anchored under the South shore
we discover'd a Bay,\* \(\* Botany Bay\.\) which\s+appeared to be tollerably well shelter'd

entries.title: Stranded on the Great Barrier Reef
anchors: before the Man at the Lead could heave another cast, the Ship Struck\s+and stuck fast
we had got upon\s+the South-East Edge of a reef of Coral Rocks
